sources.description: Supplementary spreadsheet (jcbfm201235x1.xls) of Howarth, Gleeson and Attwell (2012); this project uses the sheet 'Cerebral cortex - calculations'
sources.publisher: Journal of Cerebral Blood Flow and Metabolism / PubMed Central (PMC3390818)
sources.retrieval_note: PMC served a browser proof-of-work page instead of the file and Europe PMC reports the article is not in the open-access subset; the Internet Archive capture of the PMC file (2023-04-26) was used. Its OLE metadata names the author as Clare Howarth, last saved 2012-02-07.
sources.terms: The spreadsheet's 'Help & Use' sheet: it may be used freely to investigate the effects of changing the parameters or adapted to other cell types or regions; the authors ask that the paper be acknowledged in published results. The .xls is not redistributed in the package; extracted values and formulas are, with this attribution.
sources.citation: Howarth C, Gleeson P, Attwell D (2012). Updated energy budgets for neural computation in the neocortex and cerebellum. J Cereb Blood Flow Metab 32(7):1222-1232. doi:10.1038/jcbfm.2012.35

sources.description: Full text of the paper, used for the numbers it prints (signaling 20.4, housekeeping 6.79, total 27.2 umol ATP/g/min; process percentages; overlap-factor comparison; housekeeping range; sleep versus running)

selection: One declared reference case: the cerebral cortex sheet as distributed. The cerebellar sheets are not used.

steps: refuse a file whose sha256 differs from the pinned value
parameter table: rows with a number in column B (label, value, cited reference, note)
formulas: every FORMULA record of the sheet, shared formulas resolved, decompiled with xlrd's formula decompiler, with the cell's cached value
numbers typed in the calculation area (columns E onward) that are not formulas
text labels of the calculation area

authored_inputs.src/neural_budget/scenarios/*.toml: seven scenario files, each with its source
